user.title: Select installation type
user.description: Choose whether this instance imports states from another instance, or lets other instances connect to it.

entity_selection.title: Choose remote entities
entity_selection.description: The remote instance exposes {count} entities. Select the domains or entities to import. Exclusions take precedence. To import everything, select Import all entities.

exclude.name: Exclude
exclude.description: Excluded domains and entities are never imported, even if included.

reauth_confirm.title: Update remote access token
reauth_confirm.description: The remote instance rejected the saved token. Create a new long-lived access token on that instance and enter it here.

reconfigure.title: Change connection to {name}
reconfigure.description: Leave the access token empty to keep the saved one.

error.unsupported_version: Unsupported version. At least version 0.111 is required.
error.missing_endpoint: You need to install Remote Home Assistant on this host and add remote_homeassistant: to its configuration.
error.select_entities: Select at least one domain or entity, or choose Import all entities.

abort.reauth_successful: Reauthentication successful. The remote connection is using the new token.
abort.wrong_instance: The token belongs to a different remote Home Assistant instance.
abort.not_supported: No configuration options supported for a remote node
abort.yaml_managed: This connection is defined in YAML. Change it in configuration.yaml.

user.title: Attribute filter
user.description: Ignore state updates of matching entities when the value is outside the limits. Entity ID accepts wildcards such as `sensor.*_power`; leave it empty to match all entities.

reconfigure.title: Edit attribute filter
reconfigure.description: Ignore state updates of matching entities when the value is outside the limits. Entity ID accepts wildcards such as `sensor.*_power`; leave it empty to match all entities.

error.missing_limit: Set at least one limit: Ignore above or Ignore below.

init.title: Remote options
init.description:
Imported entities: **{selected}** of {total} currently reported by the remote.
Attribute filters: **{filters}**. Add or edit them from the integration page with **Add filter**.

entities.title: Domains and entities
entities.description: With the saved selection, **{selected}** of {total} remote entities are imported.

exclude.name: Exclude
exclude.description: Excluded domains and entities are never imported, even if included.

naming.title: Entity naming
naming.description: Prefixes are added to the entity IDs and names of imported entities.

events.title: Subscribed events
events.description: Search for existing events or type a new event name in Events. Remove a selected event using its chip, then submit to save.
